key.reply_ask: Thank the author, confirm that CI now passes, and say the PR is going to a maintainer for review.

Notes that the author asked zulipbot to remove "not ready" himself, so no maintainer has signed off yet and the triager still needs to add "maintainer review" and assign a reviewer.
Suggests Niloth P, the most frequent recent committer to the slack_incoming files, as the reviewer.
Flags that karlstolley closed the author's other PR #40356 on 2026-10-10 over possible AI-policy problems, so the reviewer should keep this in mind.
Describes the changes since the feedback as formatting fixes plus a new event_message_changed.json fixture, with the same approach, not a rewrite.
